newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asian Terminals upgrades container yard.
newsitem.headline: Asian Terminals upgrades container yard.

text.p: Asian Terminals Inc said on Friday it would soon complete the upgrading of its container yard at the Manila south harbour.
The port operator said in a statement it expected construction of five rubber-tyred gantries for container stacking to be completed next month.
The project is part of an expansion at Pier 5, where a new berth which can accommodate three container ships, each with a capacity in escess of 3,500 twenty-foot containers, is being built.
